synth.notes:
Single horizontal mirror axis (wall) + 3x3-block pieces + targets; render layers piece>reflection>target>wall, then re-extract.
A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece one block row; A3/A4 move the selected piece one block column; bounds 21x21 blocks, pieces cannot overlap.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces largest first (block count, then min block) -> axis. This is the missed step-64 mechanic: the 7-block L goes to the 6-block T.
wall_h/piece names rank 4-connected components of own cells plus all 0 cells; wall "born" means a target splits the axis. Passes stateless.
Unconfirmed: largest-first may really be internal sprite order. With no 0 visible, selected = piece whose centres all show targets.
